security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self' blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Open any PDF as a real book
bundle.longDescription: Paper Book opens PDFs, especially illustrated storybooks, as a book you turn by hand, in a cozy reading room with ribbons, a watch and a magnifier.
